b_01KX97RSAGKR4W4861A4V5BKBC.subject: media_strategy
b_01KX97RSAGKR4W4861A4V5BKBC.content: The project prioritizes fast media delivery over maximum compression quality, using FAST settings for both images and video without AV1 encoding.
b_01KX97RSAGKR4W4861A4V5BKBC.falsification_test: If compression settings are changed to quality-focused modes or AV1 is enabled, this belief would be wrong.

b_01KX97RSAGHXMM8QYQD135AFP6.subject: domain_separation
b_01KX97RSAGHXMM8QYQD135AFP6.content: The project separates frontend (vakoori.com) and backend (breisera.com) under distinct domains, suggesting a decoupled architecture.
b_01KX97RSAGHXMM8QYQD135AFP6.falsification_test: If both domains resolve to the same server or the backend domain is not actively used, this belief would be wrong.
